reason: one physical host: the nodes, the relays and the chain are separated by Linux network namespaces and firewall rules, not by machines; the relays and the chain are operated by the run itself; no internet path exists

builds.ai: GOWORK=off CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -tags roomtest ./messenger/cmd/tos-messengerd; go build -trimpath ./messenger/cmd/tos-messenger-owner ./protocol/cmd/tos-service-packet-relay

topology.bridge: tosmr-br0 <ns-subnet>/24, host end <ns-bridge>, no default route in any namespace

roles.c: node C, a member that refuses unknown senders without an invite
roles.d: filler joiner D (A adds and removes it only to make Commits; it never posts)
roles.f: filler joiner F (likewise; its Add after the idle pulls the members' retired evidence)

topology.chain: three validators in the host namespace on 127.0.0.1, JSON-RPC ports [49880, 49881, 49882]
topology.firewall: node namespaces: outgoing only to the relays' port 8443 and <ns-bridge> JSON-RPC ports, no incoming connection; relay namespaces: incoming only to port 8443, no outgoing connection; host bridge table: every node-to-node frame dropped
topology.files: each namespace process runs with empty read-only tmpfs mounts over the other parties' directories and the run's private files

not_openfox: creating, funding and activating the wallets with tosctl and the zerostate faucet
each node's Messaging Endpoint identity and its commitment on chain (scripts/messenger-relay-e2e-tool identity; tosctl agent native-registry action --kind delegate)
signing owner decisions with the owner key (tos-messenger-owner sign) and issuing C's invites (tos-messenger-owner prepare-invite and submit), as each node's owner
the network namespaces, firewall rules, forwarders and the relay daemons
the Messenger runtime calls (scripts/messenger-relay-e2e-tool call): this script is the Agent runtime of every node
the crafted room objects (scripts/messenger-relay-e2e-tool room-frames and craft) and this script's relay reads and deposits
driver_hold: A's daemon runs the OpenMLS driver through a test wrapper that waits 3 s while a marker exists (only during the authority crash window of item 15)
chat_owner_socket: each node's rail configuration names chat.owner_socket, the daemon's owner_socket_path

admission.a: allow-list: B, C, D, E, F (unknown senders: require-admission)

daemon_configuration.note: the re-deposit interval is the shortest the daemon accepts (a test MAY set 10 min to 20 h, spec 4); the descriptor lifetime is short so the evidence pull and the descriptor-expired retry run live
